# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is overwhelmingly **operational/logistics chatter** — transporter coordination (Raipur/Nagpur/Vizag trailer bookings), driver call-holds, MTC/TC certificate issuance for site engineers (Vinoth, Vigneshwaran), payment-release follow-ups, and internal production/cutting-line calls (Yuvraj Operator series). Only a **minority of calls are genuine sales conversations** — rate enquiries, quantity negotiation, order conversion, or dealer price haggling. The clearest sales threads come from:

- **Tirupati Balasubramaniam** — a re-seller/dealer negotiating TMT rates, bargaining logic, and competitive intelligence from Chennai vs AP markets.
- **Uniqcore Const Balakrishnan** — a fabrication/construction buyer price-shopping structural steel (plate, ISMB, angle, round) across multiple calls, converging on a running rate card.
- **V R Earth Movers**, **V KUMAR**, **Vinayaga Steel Pradeep**, **Vidveda Krishnasamy**, **VIMALADEVI K**, **Vasanth Narasimhan**, **VJR developers**, **Vinodini Sharathi** — repeat B2B buyers doing rate enquiry → negotiation → order-confirm cycles for sheets/plates/TMT/structural sections.
- Several **dead/short enquiry calls** (one-liners, wrong numbers, voicemails) with zero sales content.

Because genuine negotiated-sale calls are a small subset of a much larger logistics corpus, this KB stays tightly grounded in only those exchanges and avoids inventing scope (no roofing sheets, no retail/B2C scripts beyond what's shown).

## Products & brand ladder

Based only on items actually quoted/discussed:

- **TMT rebar** — sizes 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 32 mm; grades referenced: FE500, FE550D ("550D"), E250, E350. Note from Velmurugan Subbaiyan call: *"500 கிடைக்காது sir... அவங்க இப்ப 3 months-ஆ R&L production இல்ல"* [FE500 not available — RINL hasn't produced it for 3 months] — so **550D/Vizag (RINL) is the default fallback grade** pitched to customers.
- **Plates (MS/HR)** — thickness 2–25mm+, sizes like 4x8, 2500mm, 6300mm standard length, "2.5 to 12" range. Checkered plate also mentioned.
- **Structural steel** — ISMB, ISMC (channel), angle, round bar, flat, SHS/CHS (square/circular hollow section — explicitly "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல" [we don't deal SHS] in one call), build-up/PEB sections (referred out to fabricators).
- **Sheets/coils** — CR (cold-rolled) sheet, 0.6mm thickness enquiry; coil-cut conversion material discussed heavily on the ops side.
- **Brands**: SAIL (referred to as "Sale"/"சைல்"), Vizag/RINL (called "Vaisakh"/"Vizag"), Tata Steel, JSW, NMDC (plates), Apollo (pipe). Repeated clarification that **Sale and Vaisakh are "same price"** but Sale is the default push brand; Tata quoted only on request and "rate ரொம்ப high".
- Company does **not** manufacture/stock: SHS tube, PEB build-up, bolt/hanger items, CHS pipe (sourced externally only), angle-bolt (sale brand doesn't do it).

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- TMT/structural "Vizag" basic rates (Tirupati dealer thread): **10mm ₹65 → revised ₹66–68**, 12–25mm ₹65, 8mm ₹69–70. Quote: *"10 mm ₹3 increase... 68 and 8 mm 69"*.
- VJR Developers enquiry: Vizag 16–25mm = ₹65; 12mm = ₹67; 10mm = ₹69; 8mm = ₹70. Delivery (Sriperumbudur) adds **~₹500 transport extra**.
- Uniqcore Balakrishnan thread — long-running structural deal: **HR plate / ISMB / angle / round all quoted ₹65–68 + tax**, finally converged at **₹68 for HR plate (10–12mm)**, note: *"thickness வந்து 10-12 mm வரைக்கும். அதுக்கு மேல போயிடுச்சுன்னா அப்படியே ₹2000 extra"* [above that thickness, +₹2000 extra]. Final PO rates referenced: **₹71,750 / ₹73,750 / ₹75,750** (per-unit/package tiers) — confirmed unchanged across several follow-up calls.
- Vimalkumar Saveetha Institute (40 ton TMT enquiry): **12mm = ₹69, 16mm = ₹68.5**, "GST extra" (not inclusive).
- V R Earth Movers — ISMB/channel steel sheet: rate moved from **₹59–61 → ₹65.5** over weeks; also a 300x150 vs 300x140 channel swap offered at **₹60 vs ₹63** (weight/flange tradeoff explained transparently).
- V KUMAR flat-steel negotiation: opened at ₹54, buyer pushed, final closed at **₹53.50 ("535")** — explicitly called "final… you are giving best."
- Vinayaga Steel Pradeep: plate market rate **₹61–63.5**, moves ₹61.5 "same rate" to 2mm ₹63; also ₹1 dispute settled citing competitor ("Kapil") rate match.
- **Payment/transport charges**: Standard **₹200 "payment/handling charge"** on invoices; a customer caught a ₹250 overcharge and vendor issued a **debit/credit note** to correct it — indicates a disciplined no-bill-cancellation policy ("e-way bill-ல வரும்... cancel பண்றது ரொம்ப கஷ்டம்" [once e-way bill is cut, cancellation is very hard]).
- **Credit terms**: Vidveda Krishnasamy call shows **~1 month credit** window vs advance-payment rate; price difference explicitly tied to credit vs advance.
- Transport rates mentioned in sales-adjacent calls: Coimbatore ₹4600 (plate lifting), Vellore/VIT ₹3,750–3,800, Chennai ₹3,550–3,600, Bilai→Coimbatore 35-ton trailer bill-split arrangement (2-bill convention for 33+2 ton).

## Objection Playbook

**"Rate ரொம்ப ஜாஸ்தி" (price too high)**
- Response pattern used repeatedly: cite **material shortage/demand** as root cause — *"material இல்லை sir... demand இருக்கு"* — and compare local competitive landscape (e.g., Tirupati 20 dealers vs Chennai 2 distributors) to justify why a flat regional rate can't apply everywhere.
- When pressed further, reps hold firm on no-discount: *"rate கம்மியான மாதிரி பண்ண முடியாது sir... ஏன்னா rate எல்லாமே increase ஆயிடுச்சு"* (VASUDEVAN K call) — refusing a ₹500/50-paisa ask, citing "we already raised rate once, won't now cut it."

**"Competitor gives it cheaper"**
- Dealer thread response: acknowledge indirectly, then reframe via logistics/conversion cost burden (Visakhapatnam→Raipur→back) to justify margin: *"எனக்கு இந்த conversion material transportation எனக்கு அதிகம் பிடிக்கும்"*.
